historicalFormula: Equal average of unrounded eligible season grades
precision: Full precision saved. Display grades to one decimal.
missingDataPolicy: Verified zero receives 0.0. Below-minimum, unresolved and outside-NHL seasons remain ungraded. Historical averages with unresolved veteran seasons are flagged as incomplete coverage.
candidateCoverage: Players appearing in the historical window, plus explicit exceptions. This is not a complete inventory of veterans absent throughout the entire window.
note: Measures regular-season participation regardless of absence reason. No overall-value contribution assigned.
